text: So sorry to message this late, I know you must be busy with much more serious things. My son is 11 and has a temperature of 38.6. He was sick once earlier this evening but he's kept drinks down fine since then, he's had water and some squash. He's completely awake and himself, chatting away and watching TV, and he's had no fits or shaking or anything like that. I just wanted to check whether I should keep an eye on him at home or if he needs to be seen. Sorry again and thank you.
